dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible in the central and upper-left fields are three distinct 'O' shaped rings and two 'C' shaped arcs. The 'O' shapes feature a sharp, high-contrast transition from the dark background into a high-intensity white perimeter, with a secondary gradient transition back to a lower-intensity dark center. The 'C' shapes exhibit irregular, non-uniform edge geometry with a higher intensity concentration along the convex perimeter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density of isolated high-intensity blobs is low in the central dorsal region. There is a high concentration of merged, high-intensity pixel clusters on the far-left lateral aspect where lighting intensity exceeds the sensor dynamic range, resulting in loss of internal gradient. Small, solid low-intensity clusters are interspersed between the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the central region form an irregular, obtuse-angled quadrilateral. Three smaller high-intensity clusters in the lower-right quadrant form a nearly equilateral triangular relationship.
